description: Source file implementing the Display class for Android's SurfaceFlinger composition engine, including display configuration, layer management, color profiles, and interaction with hardware composer.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Represents a display device in the Android SurfaceFlinger composition engine, managing configuration, layers, color profiles, and hardware interactions.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Factory function to create a shared pointer to a Display instance.

methods.name: ~Display
methods.description: Destructor for the Display class.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the display with provided creation arguments.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the display is valid and properly initialized.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the display's identifier.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Indicates if the display is secure.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the display is virtual.

methods.name: getDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the display's optional ID.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the display from hardware.

methods.name: setColorTransform
methods.description: Sets the color transform matrix for the display.

methods.name: setColorProfile
methods.description: Sets the color profile for the display.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the display's current state for debugging.

methods.name: createDisplayColorProfile
methods.description: Creates and sets a display color profile.

methods.name: createRenderSurface
methods.description: Creates a render surface for the display.

methods.name: createClientCompositionCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for client composition requests.

methods.name: createOutputLayer
methods.description: Creates an output layer for a given layer FE.

methods.name: setReleasedLayers
methods.description: Sets layers that are released after composition.

methods.name: applyDisplayBrightness
methods.description: Applies display brightness settings.

methods.name: beginFrame
methods.description: Begins a new frame for composition.

methods.name: chooseCompositionStrategy
methods.description: Selects the composition strategy based on current state.

methods.name: applyCompositionStrategy
methods.description: Applies the chosen composition strategy.

methods.name: getSkipColorTransform
methods.description: Checks if color transform can be skipped.

methods.name: allLayersRequireClientComposition
methods.description: Determines if all layers require client-side composition.

methods.name: applyChangedTypesToLayers
methods.description: Applies device composition type changes to layers.

methods.name: applyDisplayRequests
methods.description: Applies display-specific requests.

methods.name: applyLayerRequestsToLayers
methods.description: Applies layer-specific requests.

methods.name: applyClientTargetRequests
methods.description: Applies client target properties to the display.

methods.name: presentAndGetFrameFences
methods.description: Presents the current frame and retrieves synchronization fences.

methods.name: setExpensiveRenderingExpected
methods.description: Indicates whether expensive rendering is expected.

methods.name: isPowerHintSessionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if power hint session is enabled.

methods.name: setHintSessionGpuFence
methods.description: Sets a GPU fence for power hint sessions.

methods.name: finishFrame
methods.description: Completes the current frame, finalizing composition.
